x: Welcome to Steve Webster and congratulations to Duncan, David, Kevin, Dean, Gavin, Nadir and Saul on gaining representative honours. 14th OCTOBER 1984 COLLINGWOOD OPEN - 3 MILES
Steve Webster pulled off some fine runs, studies permitting! While exceptional quality performances were provided by Glyn Tiernan not least in the Southern.

However tucked away in the results you'll find confirmation of the improvement of many of our younger members with the fine 3000m times of Juniors, Graham Adams and Simon Maynard, and Youth, Steve Webster - a new club record - the most notable.
Steve Webster carried a heavy burden as 4th scorer in such a team, but he performed with great credit to clinch second place for Belgrave, only 4 points behind the winners.
